title: Capricorn, caught off-schedule
old_caption: A spreadsheet on the morning run, a five-year plan for a houseplant, a reply in bullet points. Then 'one more walk?' at 8:52, and the planner went flying. What's the best thing you never planned?

title: The Out-of-Office Date
old_caption: Can't switch off, even on your day off? Close the laptop and take yourself somewhere slow. Resting is a skill, and you're allowed to practise it.

title: Party of One
old_caption: Scared to eat alone in public? Nobody is staring. They're reading menus. Order exactly what you want and enjoy every bite.

title: Phone in the Drawer
old_caption: One hour, no phone, just you. The urge to check fades faster than you think, and your own thoughts turn out to be decent company.

title: The Slow Lap
old_caption: Rushing even on your day off? Walk slowly, sit for the sunrise, let the snail win. The point was never to finish first, just to be there.

title: Nobody Else Gets a Vote
old_caption: Always picking what everyone else would want? On a solo date there is one vote, and it's yours. Start with what you actually like.

title: Stop Saving the Nice Plates
old_caption: Saving the good plates for a special someone? You're already here. Make Tuesday the occasion and treat yourself like a guest worth fussing over.

title: No Audience
old_caption: Does it only count if someone sees it? Put the phone face down, dance in the kitchen, watch the sunset without filming it. Some moments are just for you.

title: No Itinerary
old_caption: Need a plan for everything? Try one afternoon with no list. Getting a little lost is how you find the bakery you never would have planned.

title: The Back Row Matinee
old_caption: Hate letting anyone see you feel things? Take yourself to a matinee and cry at the sad part. Feeling it all is allowed, and nobody keeps score.
